description: Building Energy Consumption 2 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Mathematical Research Data Initiative, Xia Chen (Technical University of Munich). The dataset consists of synthetic building-design configurations and their corresponding heating energy demand, generated using a first-principles building-energy simulation workflow. The simulation systematically varies geometric properties, envelope thermal characteristics, air permeability, glazing ratios, and internal gains to produce physically consistent building designs and their resulting heating loads. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
